function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment arm has a lower overall response rate than the control arm (-0.083), but this is confounded by baseline severity. Clinicians assigned the treatment preferentially to sicker patients (higher severity), who have lower response rates regardless of treatment. Without adjusting for severity, the raw difference is misleading.", "implication": "The raw difference in proportions (treatment minus control) is not a valid estimate of treatment effect because the groups are systematically different in baseline severity. Thus, we report the raw difference, but with a caveat that it is confounded."}
function.name: note_finding
